facts.text: Car trouble? Come back to my camp. I've got a fire going and a feed on, plenty for everyone.
facts.why: This could not be matched to any opened Mick Taylor quote. The plot has Mick offering a tow to his camp to fix the car, so the idea is right but the words are unconfirmed.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the backpackers stop at the roadhouse.
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot has them buying fuel at a petrol station before the crater. A roadhouse stop is not stated.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the backpackers stop for fuel on the highway.

vibe.verdict: Right crater camp and the knife nod is a good one, but the cheery camp tone is off for a horror film and the look is plain.
missing: Mick's 'head on a stick' line (the shed)
Ben's camera footage showing Mick followed them from the petrol station
Liz hiding in Mick's garage of cars (the mine site)
Mick's long tall stories while he pretends to fix the car (the camp)
The title card saying no trace of Liz or Kristy was found
ideas: Swap 'Road trip honey soy roasted nuts' note for 'The petrol station where it began' to fix the roadhouse cue
Replace 'Bundaberg rum and dry' note with a 'Tall stories' line for Mick at the fire
Swap the 'Mess hall door' heading for a darker 'Crater entry notice' look
Replace 'Campfire sausage and onion sandwiches' with a billy-boiled meal named for Mick's camp
